_meta.title: Refocus (depth lens blur)
_meta.description: Click-to-refocus a photo: Depth Anything 3 (core LoadDA3Model / DA3Inference mono / DA3Render depth, v2_style, near = white) -> cj_image_tools CJRefocus, a layered depth-of-field blur: per-pixel circle of confusion from |depth - focal depth| x aperture, focal depth sampled at the clicked point (focus_x / focus_y, normalized), each CoC layer blurred with its own disc and composited back-to-front so sharp subjects never halo into the blurred background, optional highlight bokeh boost in linear light. Builder: src/lib/oj/refocus.ts. Model (models/geometry_estimation): depth_anything_3_mono_large.safetensors (default) or depth_anything_3_base.safetensors (fast).
